head: ea5a00d0e3a706eef4a07788f8fe68e1c92c7334
scope: ywz65's integer-address signed-SWAP tariff extends the credited PR2544/2415/1989 cuts. Reviewed disjoint mod2 ADD and determinant-sign crossing charges, all-register rank subadditivity, exact attaining signed words, and finite-support separation for a fixed word over an unbounded modulus family. Complete formal endpoint, rational price, dirty spectator, quotient-blind-spot and invalid-unit controls are replayed. The sharp price r(2min(A,B)+max(A,B))+tC is for the specified formal alphabet, not optimized words at a single modulus, physical cost or a supplier.
